guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 旋轉閘門力矩、河潮聯合作用與長期調適。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Rotating-gate torque, combined river and tidal effects, and long-term adaptation. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 官方防洪閘橫跨約520 m河道。
官方系統共有10座鋼製閘門。
教學旋轉門分項力矩合成為4.5 MN·m。
教學300 m³/s淨入流持續2 h使平均水位上升0.108 m。
教學三角力脈衝衝量為0.4 MN·s。
教學40年線性海平面情境增量0.20 m。
factsEn: The official barrier spans approximately 520 m of river.
The official system comprises 10 steel gates.
Teaching component moments combine to 4.5 MN·m.
Teaching inflow 300 m³/s for two hours raises mean level 0.108 m.
The teaching triangular force pulse has impulse 0.4 MN·s.
The teaching forty-year linear sea-level scenario adds 0.20 m.
timeline: 1974　泰晤士河防洪閘開始建設，進入河口大型活動結構施工階段。
1982　泰晤士河防洪閘開始具備實際運轉防洪功能。
1984　五月八日正式啟用典禮，與開始運轉年份有所區別。
timelineEn: 1974 — Construction of the Thames Barrier begins, establishing the movable estuary structure.
1982 — The Thames Barrier becomes operational for practical flood protection.
1984 — Formal opening takes place on May eight, distinct from the operational starting year.
codes: 美國陸軍工兵團工程手冊：水工鋼結構設計，EM 1110-2-2107
美國陸軍工兵團土木工程機電設計手冊，EM 1110-2-2610，2025
codesEn: USACE Design of Hydraulic Steel Structures, EM 1110-2-2107
USACE Mechanical and Electrical Design for Civil Works Structures, EM 1110-2-2610, 2025
landmarks: 泰晤士河防洪閘：旋轉門體
馬仕朗防潮閘：航道閉合比較
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：泰晤士河防洪閘
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Thames Barrier
guides.concept: 本課以泰晤士河防洪閘為入口，深入旋轉閘門力矩、河潮聯合作用與長期調適。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Using Thames Barrier as its entry point, this course examines rotating-gate torque, combined river and tidal effects, and long-term adaptation. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
procedure: 旋轉閘門的驅動需求來自重量、浮力、水壓與摩擦的合成力矩。各力臂隨角度改變，最大水壓不一定對應最大驅動需求。 假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。 密封摩擦、沉積物與軸承偏心會讓負載峰值偏離理想曲線。若只以平均馬達功率檢查能力，短暫的起動高扭矩和局部拘束可能被完全掩蓋。
天文潮與氣象暴潮的峰值可能不同時到達。簡單線性相加可說明相位重要性，真實河口中摩擦與水深又使交互作用非線性。 假設潮位2cosθ m、暴潮1cos(θ+60°) m，合成振幅√(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m，非兩峰直接相加3 m。 取兩個不同時刻的最大值相加可能過度保守，也可能忽略風暴改變潮波傳播後的新峰值。模型驗證若只比最高水位，會漏掉危險持續時間。
阻隔海潮時，上游河流仍持續入流，受保護河段因此變成暫時蓄水體。可用庫容取決於沿岸高程與支流，不能只看閘前水位。 假設關閉期間淨入流300 m³/s持續2 h、有效水面20 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m；忽略側向溢流與面積隨水位變化。 只防海側高水位而忽略河流洪峰，可能把洪水留在防線內側。以平坦水面替代長河段水力坡降，還會低估某些支流交會處的局部水位。

活動防洪結構同時是航運通道，通航窗口受水位、橋下空間與設備可用性約束。平均船舶到達率無法描述尖峰排隊與關閉後的復原時間。 假設停航3 h、到達率4 vessels/h，累積12 vessels；重開後處理6 vessels/h且仍到達4 vessels/h，清空需12/(6−4)=6 h。 若重開後服務率只等於到達率，既有隊列永遠無法消散。把通過閘區的時間與完整航段時間混用，則會錯算容量並掩蓋航道瓶頸。
下沉式門體需要特定運動空間，門槽沉積改變淨空與局部水流。平均淤積厚度不能代表單個硬物或高點，幾何檢查必須覆蓋整段掃掠體積。 假設槽底面積400 m²、均勻淤積厚0.08 m，沉積體積32 m³；若濕容重16 kN/m³，重量512 kN，不代表驅動附加力。 均勻沉積假設會低估孤立塊體造成的卡阻，移除沉積也可能暴露既有底板損傷。若只用挖除體積驗收，不能證明全部運動空間已恢復。
液壓驅動把流體壓力與流量轉成機械功率，泵的電功率還包含損失。相同壓力下流量不足會降低速度，不能只憑壓力表判斷動作能力。 假設壓差12 MPa、流量0.02 m³/s、總效率0.8，輸入功率ΔpQ/η=300 kW；穩定流量，未含加速與儲能器瞬態。 內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。只檢查電流或單點壓力，可能把效率惡化誤認為正常的負載變動。
防洪閘與兩岸堤牆必須形成連續高程線，局部低點會繞過強大的主結構。水位基準、沉降與門檻高程的差異往往比平均牆高更重要。 假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。 主閘設計再強也不能彌補遠端牆頂低點，局部沉降又可能持續發展。以地圖等高線代替接縫精密測量，會把繞流通道藏在資料解析度之下。
波浪撞擊的峰值和持續時間共同決定脈衝，短脈衝對柔性構件的作用不同於同峰值的長載重。靜水壓力不能替代瞬態結構反應。 假設三角形力脈衝峰值2 MN、歷時0.4 s，衝量J=FmaxΔt/2=0.4 MN·s；未由此直接求位移或疲勞。 低取樣率可能完全漏掉撞擊峰值，過度放大峰值而忽略面積與相位也會誤判總力。氣泡含量及局部接觸使相鄰壓力計不一定同步到峰。
定期測試只能發現被測功能的故障，無法保證未施加的環境與荷載。檢測間隔與潛伏失效機率相關，但獨立恆定失效率只是基礎模型。 假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003；限λT很小及完美檢測。 若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。維修造成的暫時停用也屬可用度問題，不能因主設備故障率低就忽略。

長期海平面變化會改變關閉頻率、河流排水窗口和維護時間，而不只提高一道設計水位。情境外推用來比較方案，並非保證未來趨勢。 假設線性相對海平面上升5 mm/year持續40 years，增量0.20 m；另假設加速項0.05 mm/year²，額外0.5at²=0.04 m。 以單一線性速率規劃全部壽命，可能忽略加速、區域沉降與潮汐改變。若只加高牆體而不評估關閉增加，設備疲勞和內河排水需求仍可能失配。
procedureEn: Drive demand combines moments from weight, buoyancy, water pressure and friction. Lever arms vary with angle, so maximum water pressure need not coincide with maximum required drive torque. At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m. Required torque is 4.5 MN·m for that static posture only. Seal friction, sediment and bearing eccentricity shift peaks away from ideal curves. Average motor power can conceal brief breakaway torque demands and local restraint that govern actual motion capability.

Astronomical tide and meteorological surge can peak at different times. Linear addition illustrates phase effects, while friction and changing depth make real estuarine interaction nonlinear. Assume tide 2cosθ m and surge 1cos(θ+60°) m. Combined amplitude is √(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m, rather than the direct peak sum of 3 m. Adding maxima from separate times can be overly conservative yet still miss peaks created by changed tidal propagation. Validation limited to peak level overlooks the duration of hazardous conditions.

When sea levels are excluded, river inflow continues and the protected reach temporarily stores water. Available storage depends on bank elevations and tributaries, not only the level beside the barrier. Assume net inflow 300 m³/s for two hours over effective area 20 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m, excluding lateral spill and changes of area with stage. Excluding the sea while overlooking a river flood can retain water inside the defence. Replacing a long river gradient with a flat surface can underestimate levels near particular tributary junctions.

A movable flood defence is also a navigation route. Windows depend on level, clearance and availability; average vessel arrivals do not describe peak queues or recovery after a closure. Assume closure three hours with arrival rate four vessels per hour, accumulating twelve vessels. After reopening, service six and arrivals four per hour require 12/(6−4)=6 hours to clear. If reopened service merely matches arrivals, the existing queue never clears. Mixing barrier-crossing time with complete-route time miscalculates capacity and conceals bottlenecks elsewhere in the navigation channel.

A recessed gate requires a defined swept space. Sediment changes clearance and local flow, while average deposit thickness cannot represent isolated hard objects or high spots across that volume. Assume recess area 400 m² with uniform deposit 0.08 m thick: volume 32 m³. At wet unit weight 16 kN/m³, weight is 512 kN, not the added drive force. Uniform deposits underestimate jamming from isolated blocks, and removal can expose existing sill damage. Excavated volume alone cannot establish that the entire required swept space has been restored.

Hydraulic drives convert pressure and flow into mechanical power, while electrical input also covers losses. Insufficient flow reduces speed even at normal pressure, so a gauge alone cannot establish movement capability. Assume pressure difference 12 MPa, flow 0.02 m³/s and overall efficiency 0.8. Input ΔpQ/η=300 kW, for steady flow without acceleration or accumulator transients. Internal leakage can preserve pressure while reducing useful cylinder flow, and heating changes viscosity. Current or pressure alone may make declining efficiency look like an ordinary change in external loading.

Barrier and bank defences must form a continuous elevation line. Local low points bypass strong main structures, making datum consistency, settlement and sill elevation more important than average wall height. Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m. Remaining geometric freeboard is 0.58 m, excluding wave runup and probabilistic margins. A strong main barrier cannot compensate for a distant low crest, and settlement may continue. Coarse map contours can hide bypass routes that require detailed joint and crossing surveys.

Wave impact depends on both peak and duration. A short impulse affects a flexible member differently from a sustained load of equal peak, so hydrostatics cannot substitute for transient structural response. Assume a triangular force pulse with peak 2 MN and duration 0.4 s. Impulse J=FmaxΔt/2=0.4 MN·s; displacement and fatigue are not obtained from this alone. Low sampling may miss impact peaks, while multiplying one peak over the entire area misstates total force. Air content and local contact mean adjacent sensors need not peak simultaneously.

Periodic tests reveal only exercised failures, not untested environments and loads. Test interval influences latent unavailability, but constant independent failure rate is only a basic model. Assume latent failure rate λ=0.0002/day and perfect-test interval 30 days. Mean unavailability is approximately λT/2=0.003, for small λT and complete detection. Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk. Maintenance outages also reduce availability and cannot be ignored merely because the main equipment has a low failure rate.

Long-term sea-level change affects closure frequency, drainage windows and maintenance time, not only a design level. Scenario extrapolation compares options rather than guaranteeing a future trend. Assume linear relative sea-level rise 5 mm/year over 40 years, giving 0.20 m. An assumed acceleration 0.05 mm/year² adds 0.5at²=0.04 m. One linear rate may miss acceleration, local subsidence and tidal change. Raising walls without examining more frequent closures can leave equipment fatigue and inland drainage demands poorly matched.
evidence: 以旋轉門體驅動力矩編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿轉角建立分項力矩曲線，對照油壓、位置與轉速資料；分開啟動摩擦和持續轉動阻力，避免只用終點水位解釋整段動作。
以暴潮相位與潮汐疊加編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把不同來源水位換到同一時間與高程基準，檢查預報相位誤差；比較水深不同期間的殘差，以辨識線性疊加何時不再適用。
以關閉期間河水蓄積編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用上游流量、支流雨量與多站水位建立同期水量平衡，檢查水面坡度是否仍可用單一儲水面積描述；另計未量測的側向流入。
以通航窗口與排程編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用匿名化船舶到達與通過時間畫累積曲線，核對服務率是否受船型和潮向影響；將安全間隔和商業需求分列，避免把理論容量當保證。
以門槽沉積與淨空編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用可重複定位的測深與影像核對槽底高點，區分鬆散泥砂和硬質異物；把門體掃掠幾何疊合測量面，保存清理前後差異。
evidenceEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rotating-gate drive torque, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Build component moment curves against angle and compare pressure, position and speed. Separate breakaway friction from running resistance instead of explaining an entire movement by the final water level.

Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for surge phase and tidal superposition, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Convert water levels to common time and elevation references and examine phase errors. Compare residuals across different depths to identify when linear superposition ceases to represent the estuary.

Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for river storage during closure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Build a synchronized balance from river flow, tributary rainfall and multiple water-level stations. Test whether one storage area still represents the water-surface slope and estimate unmeasured lateral inflow separately.

Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for navigation windows and scheduling, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Plot cumulative anonymous arrival and transit records, checking vessel-type and tidal effects on service rate. Separate safety spacing from commercial demand instead of presenting theoretical capacity as guaranteed throughput.

Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for gate-recess sediment and clearance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Use repeatable bathymetry and imagery to identify high spots and distinguish loose sediment from hard debris. Overlay the gate swept volume on surveyed surfaces and preserve before-and-after changes.
pitfalls: 密封摩擦、沉積物與軸承偏心會讓負載峰值偏離理想曲線。若只以平均馬達功率檢查能力，短暫的起動高扭矩和局部拘束可能被完全掩蓋。
只防海側高水位而忽略河流洪峰，可能把洪水留在防線內側。以平坦水面替代長河段水力坡降，還會低估某些支流交會處的局部水位。
均勻沉積假設會低估孤立塊體造成的卡阻，移除沉積也可能暴露既有底板損傷。若只用挖除體積驗收，不能證明全部運動空間已恢復。
主閘設計再強也不能彌補遠端牆頂低點，局部沉降又可能持續發展。以地圖等高線代替接縫精密測量，會把繞流通道藏在資料解析度之下。
若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。維修造成的暫時停用也屬可用度問題，不能因主設備故障率低就忽略。
pitfallsEn: Seal friction, sediment and bearing eccentricity shift peaks away from ideal curves. Average motor power can conceal brief breakaway torque demands and local restraint that govern actual motion capability.

Excluding the sea while overlooking a river flood can retain water inside the defence. Replacing a long river gradient with a flat surface can underestimate levels near particular tributary junctions.

Uniform deposits underestimate jamming from isolated blocks, and removal can expose existing sill damage. Excavated volume alone cannot establish that the entire required swept space has been restored.
A strong main barrier cannot compensate for a distant low crest, and settlement may continue. Coarse map contours can hide bypass routes that require detailed joint and crossing surveys.

Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk. Maintenance outages also reduce availability and cannot be ignored merely because the main equipment has a low failure rate.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘
related.transfer: 可遷移「旋轉門體驅動力矩」與「防線接續高程」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Rotating-gate drive torque" and "Continuous defence elevations" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Maeslant storm-surge barrier must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦旋轉閘門力矩、河潮聯合作用與長期調適；荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘則以浮運沉降、球鉸傳力與風暴期間可靠度的共同分析為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on rotating-gate torque, combined river and tidal effects, and long-term adaptation; Maeslant storm-surge barrier centres on joint analysis of flotation, sinking, spherical-joint loading and storm reliability, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「旋轉門體驅動力矩」與「浮運吃水與壓載」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「止水縫漏流診斷」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Rotating-gate drive torque” and “Floating draft and ballast”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Maeslant storm-surge barrier, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Seal leakage diagnosis", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 泰晤士河防洪閘
history.text: 泰晤士河防洪閘以橫跨河道的活動閘門保護倫敦，與上游河流、兩岸防線及河口潮汐共同作用。泰晤士河防洪閘開始建設，進入河口大型活動結構施工階段。 泰晤士河防洪閘開始具備實際運轉防洪功能。 五月八日正式啟用典禮，與開始運轉年份有所區別。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。
history.textEn: The Thames Barrier protects London through movable gates across the river, interacting with upstream flow, bank defences and estuarine tides. Construction of the Thames Barrier begins, establishing the movable estuary structure. The Thames Barrier becomes operational for practical flood protection. Formal opening takes place on May eight, distinct from the operational starting year. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.
